state_semantics.glb_boundary_field: impulse_states_after: canonical object path to exact after-side impulses projection for every object including empty projections; GLB04 only

steps: Create P08 under explicit Agent04 at constructed level and retain returned accepted program revision.
Evaluate through duration; inspect before/after the impulse boundary and final state.
Perform one source-authorized occurrence patch producing exact P09 bytes/revision; repeat independently from P08 to exact P10.
Compare each accepted result against fixed P08/P09/P10 values and source/geometry/PBR invariants.
operational_cases.must_not_substitute: Two unrelated direct compiler calls are not proof of the Agent source-patch workflow.

steps: Accept P01, then submit a candidate with N19 source as evaluated admission.
Require rejection, prior accepted source unchanged, no failed run published as successful.
Repeat same request ID and identical payload; require the inherited idempotent result.
Reuse request ID with changed payload; require inherited conflict/rejection.
Inspect an earlier accepted revision after a later accepted revision; never accept a never-accepted candidate as a mesh/read source.
Use separate Agent02/03/04 database filenames and schema identities.
Open an explicitly wrong-version store; reject before journal/DDL/migration or bytes change.
Require selected04 protocol, implementation, program revision and run provenance for state reuse.
Exercise malformed/corrupt SQLite startup and directory database paths through explicit CLI selection; controlled error with no traceback or source/artifact mutation.
Read P02 native geometry summary and paged triangles through Agent04.
Require public profile surface-0.1 and inherited page/summary schema versions and geometry hash meaning.
Require private signed cursor context binds protocol04 and entry_profile impulse-0.1 as well as inherited query context.
Vary revision, occurrence, region, implementation, protocol or entry profile; no mixed cursor page accepted.
Retain original 02/03 declaring profile for imported definitions in catalog/source projections.
Inspect P03 impulse state with world and valid nonworld top-level pose expression frames.
Require ordinary pose/velocity conversion according to inherited rules, but every explicitly world/self impulse record byte-equivalent across those projections.
Compute exact logical entries of each full success envelope, including implementation, progress, cursors and all latest-boundary records.
Set max_value_entries to that exact value; require success if other limits admit it.
Set it to one less with a fresh request/project; require resource failure and atomic rollback of run/source/artifact effects.
Run both inspection and final export-delivery response boundary variants.
Charge complete boundary impulse_states_after records before metadata allocation and serialized GLB publication, using the shared weighted sampling bound.
operational_cases.sample_bound: legacy base + 4*object_count + max over authored boundaries of total per-object retained latest-group application weights; constructing before t0 excludes future application groups

steps: Use an authored bounded sequence with enough impulse records to exceed a deliberately lowered current output budget; charge every retained record before snapshot duplication.
Require explicit OKL-E-RESOURCE and no shortened successful record list.
Include several objects whose latest impulse boundaries differ so retained groups coexist.
Compare sparse and dense requested sample schedules against the conservative bound; never undercount an intermediate latest group.
Inject cooperative cancellation during each newly introduced compiler event iteration, event-application record loop, complete-history sample-bound loop and GLB angular-bound loop.
Require cancellation receipt, no partial successful snapshot/GLB and unchanged accepted transaction state.
Retry with cancellation absent and adequate current limits; recover the fixed analytic result.
For every delivery_required source case, build actual accepted Agent04 source-to-GLB04 delivery and retain exact .ok closure, source/program/runtime/artifact hashes and options.
Decode each delivered artifact independently with pinned Khronos validator and Three.js.
Require no validator errors/warnings, correct native triangles/winding/normals/PBR, baked-once local placement and exact source identities.
Check fixed analytical world position/orientation times from the manifest, including the high-spin case under its declared low FPS options.
Check full-turn alias/coarsened-track mutation is rejected by the independent bound and analytic sample oracle.

Require every GLB04 boundary impulse_states_after map matches the complete source-driven after-side impulses projections, including empty object projections; reject missing, changed or truncated source influence metadata.
Render the same accepted-delivery artifact validated by D01 in the pinned browser viewer.
Retain PNG bytes, actual camera/time settings, source/program/artifact/runtime identities and numerical browser readback.
Inspect correct visible shape, local placement, material regions, object placement and source-driven animation.
Missing, stale, contradictory, invalid-image or differently hashed artifact evidence leaves the gate pending.
Execute every extant regression test ID plus all new profile tests, with named results; count-only reports are insufficient.
Execute inherited core cases, Agent A01-A10, construction C01-C20, native M01-M12 and each required independent destination gate under its original bindings.
Retain current required CI jobs for Python 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 and independent 3D validation on the exact implementation inventory.
Require old default catalog payloads/hashes, source diagnostics, stores, snapshots and export labels unchanged.
Do not reuse historical release artifacts as evidence for modified runtime bytes.
